newsitem.title: USA: General Surgical says has poison pill plan.
newsitem.headline: General Surgical says has poison pill plan.

text.p: General Surgical Innovations Inc said Monday its board adopted a shareholders right plan with a 15 percent trigger.

General Surgical said the rights can not be exercised until ten days after a person or group announces acquisition of 15 percent or more of its outstanding common stock, or the start of a tender offer which would result in ownership of 15 percent or more of the outstanding common stock.
The company said each right will entitle shareholders to buy one one-thousandth of a share of its series A participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $35.00.
